faqs.question: How do I change my Wi-Fi password?
faqs.answer: Access your router's IP via a browser (usually 192.168.1.1). For a guided walkthrough, contact our WhatsApp support — an agent can help you step-by-step or do it remotely.

faqs.question: What if the router light is red (LOS)?
faqs.answer: A red LOS light means no optical signal. Check that the yellow fiber cable is firmly connected and not sharply bent. If it persists, there may be a fiber cut — report it to our support team.

faqs.question: How do I get an invoice copy?
faqs.answer: Log into the Subscriber Portal with your ID to download invoices or get payment codes. You can also request one instantly via our WhatsApp bot.

faqs.question: How long does installation take?
faqs.answer: Once your contract is approved, installation typically happens within 48 business hours, subject to availability in your area.

faqs.question: Can I change my plan?
faqs.answer: Upgrades are available anytime at no extra cost. Downgrades may require the current billing cycle to close. Contact Sales to manage the change.

faqs.question: Is the speed guaranteed?
faqs.answer: We guarantee 100% of contracted speed via Ethernet (wired) connection. Wi-Fi speeds vary based on interference, router distance, and device limitations.

faqs.question: What if my internet is slow?
faqs.answer: First, restart your router (unplug for 10 seconds). Then test speed using a network cable. If the issue continues, contact our technical team.

faqs.question: How do I schedule a technical visit?
faqs.answer: Schedule via our Official WhatsApp or call center. A technician will first run a remote diagnosis to try resolving the issue before dispatching a visit.
